import os,re,json
from collections import deque, Counter, defaultdict
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,hh,ww=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:hh]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==ww and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
def comps(I,bg):
    h,w=len(I),len(I[0]); cs=set((i,j) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if I[i][j]!=bg); seen=set(); res=[]
    for c in sorted(cs):
        if c in seen: continue
        st=[c]; comp=[c]; seen.add(c)
        while st:
            cur=st.pop()
            for dr,dc in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                n=(cur[0]+dr,cur[1]+dc)
                if n in cs and n not in seen: st.append(n); seen.add(n); comp.append(n)
        res.append(comp)
    return res
for demo in (1,2,3):

    h,w=len(I),len(I[0])

    gadgets=[comp for comp in comps(I,bg) if len(comp)>1]
    singles={(i,j,I[i][j]) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if I[i][j]!=bg and all(abs(i-a)<=1 and abs(j-b)<=1 for a,b in [])}
    # simpler: singles = non-bg cells not in any gadget
    gcells=set().union(*[set(g) for g in gadgets])
    singles=sorted(((i,j,I[i][j]) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if (i,j) in gcells or I[i][j]==bg))
    singles=sorted([(i,j,I[i][j]) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if (i,j) not in gcells and I[i][j]!=bg])
    added={O[i][j] for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if O[i][j]!=I[i][j]}
    print('=== demo',demo,'bg',bg,'added colors',sorted(added),'markers',singles)
    for mk in singles:
        mcol=mk[2]; mr,mc=mk[0],mk[1]
        # find stamped shapes near marker: compare O region vs I region
        near=[(a,b,O[a][b]) for a in range(max(0,mr-3),min(h,mr+4)) for b in range(max(0,mc-3),min(w,mc+4)) if (a,b) not in gcells and O[a][b]!=I[a][b]]
        # instead: count same-color cells in O that are new around marker, grouped
        # try: check what colors appear newly adjacent
        adj=Counter(O[a][b] for a in range(max(0,mr-2),min(h,mr+3)) for b in range(max(0,mc-2),min(w,mc+3)) if (a,b)!= (mr,mc) and O[a][b]!=I[a][b])
        print('  marker',mk,'new near:',dict(adj))

def comps_of(I,bg):
    h=len(I);w=len(I[0]);cs={(i,j) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if I[i][j]!=bg}; seen=set();res=[]
    for c in sorted(cs):

        st=[c];comp=[c];seen.add(c)
        while st:
            cur=st.pop()
            for dr,dc in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                n=(cur[0]+dr,cur[1]+dc)
                if n in cs and n not in seen: st.append(n); seen.add(n); comp.append(n)
        res.append(comp)
    return res

    yield [(i,j) for i in range(len(g)) for j in range(len(g[0]))]  # identity

from collections import Counter as C2
def comps_of(I,bg):
    h=len(I);w=len(I[0]);cs={(i,j) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if I[i][j]!=bg}; seen=set();res=[]
    for c in sorted(cs):
        if c in seen: continue
        st=[c];comp=[c];seen.add(c)
        while st:
            cur=st.pop()
            for dr,dc in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                n=(cur[0]+dr,cur[1]+dc)
                if n in cs and n not in seen: st.append(n); seen.add(n); comp.append(n)
        res.append(comp)
    return res

def f(I):
    h,w=len(I),len(I[0])
    bg=C2(x for r in I for x in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    comps=[list(g) for g in comps_of(I,bg) if len(g)>1]
    # gadgets: multi-cell comps; singles: isolated markers
    big=max(comps,key=len)
    tmpl=[(r,c,I[r][c]) for r,c in big]
    tcol=C2(I[r][c] for r,c in big).most_common(1)[0][0]
    # accent: minority color inside template
    accents=[(r,c,v) for r,c,v in tmpl if v!=tcol]
    assert len(accents)==1, accents
    ar,ac,av=accents[0]
    out=[[v for v in row] for row in I]
    singles=[(a,b,I[a][b]) for a in range(h) for b in range(w)
             if (a,b) not in set((x,y) for x,y,_ in tmpl) and I[a][b]!=bg]
    for mr,mc,v in singles:
        off=(mr-ar, mc-ac)
        for r,c,_ in tmpl:
            p,q=r+off[0],c+off[1]
            if 0<=p<h and 0<=q<w and I[p][q]==bg:
                out[p][q]=_
    return out

def solve(I):
    cnt=Counter(x for r in I for x in r); bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    C=comps(I,bg)
    templ=[]; marks=[]
    colorcount=Counter()
    for c in C:
        col=I[c[0][0]][c[0][1]]
        if len(c)>1: templ.append(c); colorcount[col]+=len(c)
        else: colorcount[col]+=1
    for c in C:
        col=I[c[0][0]][c[0][1]]
        if len(c)==1 and colorcount[col]>=3: marks.append(c)
    O=[r[:] for r in I]
    for mi,mj in sorted(next(iter(m)), for m in marks):
        v=I[mi][mj]
        fits=[]
        for tc in templ:
            acell=[p for p in tc if I[p[0]][p[1]]==v]
            if not acell: continue
            base=min(a for a,b in tc); bse=min(b for a,b in tc)
            cells=[(a-base,b-bse,I[a][b]) for a,b in tc]
            for Or in diheds(cells):
                anch=[(a,b) for a,b,_ in Or if _==v]
                for ar,acl in anch:
                    off_r=mi-ar; off_c=mj-acl
                    ok=True; fc=[]
                    for a,b,val in Or:
                        rr,cc=off_r+a,off_c+b
                        if not(0<=rr<H and 0<=cc<W): ok=False;break
                        if (rr,cc)==(mi,mj): continue
                        if I[rr][cc]!=bg: ok=False;break
                        fc.append((rr,cc,val))
                    if ok: fits.append((fc,len(fc)))
        if fits:
            fc,_=max(fits,key=lambda t:t[1])
            for r_,c_,val in fc: O[r_][c_]=val
    return O

adds=[(i,j,O_[i][j]) for i in range(len(I)) for j in range(len(I[0])) if I[i][j]!=O_[i][j]]

seen=set(); clusters=[]

    if cell in seen: continue
    st=[cell]; comp=[]
    while st:
        cur=st.pop()
        if cur in seen: continue
        seen.add(cur); comp.append(cur)
        for d_ in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
            n=(cur[0]+d_[0],cur[1]+d_[1])
            if n in adds: st.append(n)
    clusters.append(comp)
for cl in sorted(clusters,key=len,reverse=True)[:12]:
    offs=[(c[0]-min(p[0] for p in cl), c[1]-min(p[1] for p in cl)) for c in cl]
    print('size',len(cl),'colors',sorted({v for _,_,v in cl}))
    print(' offsets',sorted(offs)); print(' cells',cl[:6])

def stamp_info(I,O_):
    H,W=len(I),len(I[0])
    adds=[(i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if I[i][j]!=O_[i][j]]
    # connected components of adds (4-conn)
    seen=set(); res=[]
    for c in adds:
        if c in seen: continue
        st=[c]; comp=[]
        while st:
            cur=st.pop()
            if cur in seen: continue
            seen.add(cur); comp.append(cur)
            for d_ in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                n=(cur[0]+d_[0],cur[1]+d_[1])
                if n in adds: st.append(n)
        res.append(comp)
    return res

for d in [2,3]:
    I=G[f'Demo pair {d} input']; O_=G[f'Demo pair {d} output']
    print('=====',d)
    for cl in sorted(stamp_info(I,O_), key=len, reverse=True)[:20]:
        mi=min(p[0] for p in cl); mj=min(p[1] for p in cl)
        offs=tuple(sorted((p[0]-mi,p[1]-mj) for p in cl))
        cols=sorted({O_[p[0]][p[1]] for p in cl})
        # nearest marker
        mk=min(range(len(G['Demo pair %d input'%d])), key=lambda k: abs(k-mi)+abs(k-mj))
        print('size',len(cl),'offs',offs,'cols',cols,'near',mk)

import os,glob,re
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()

def comps(I,bg):
    H=len(I);W=len(I[0]);seen=set();out=[]
    for i in range(H):
        for j in range(W):
            if I[i][j]!=bg and (i,j) not in seen:
                st=[(i,j)];c=[]
                while st:
                    cur=st.pop()
                    if cur in seen:continue
                    seen.add(cur);c.append(cur)
                    for dr,dc in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                        n=(cur[0]+dr,cur[1]+dc)
                        if 0<=n[0]<H and 0<=n[1]<W and I[n[0]][n[1]]!=bg and n not in seen: st.append(n)
                out.append(c)
    return out

def diheds(cells):
    res=set();cur=list(cells)
    for _ in range(2):
        for _ in range(4):
            base=min(p[0] for p in cur);bse=min(p[1] for p in cur)
            res.add(tuple(sorted((a-base,b-bse,I[a][b]) for a,b,_ in cur)))
            cur=[(b,a,v) for a,b,v in cur]
        cur=[(a,-b,v) for a,b,v in cur]
    return res

def solve(I):
    H=len(I);W=len(I[0])
    cnt=Counter(x for r in I for x in r);bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    C=comps(I,bg)
    tmpl=[c for c in C if len(c)>1]
    O=[r[:] for r in I]
    for mi,mj in [(i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W)]:
        v=I[mi][mj]
        # skip if part of a multi-cell comp
        if any(mi,p_:=None): pass
        inbig=any((mi,mj) in c for c in tmpl)
        if inbig: continue
        if v==bg: continue
        cands=[]
        for tc in tmpl:
            cols={I[p[0]][p[1]] for p in tc}
            if v not in cols: continue
            for Or in diheds([(p[0],p[1],I[p[0]][p[1]]) for p in tc]):
                anc=[(a,b) for a,b,ctv in Or if ctv==v]
                if not anc: continue
                ar,acl=anc[0]
                off_r=mi-ar;off_c=mj-acl
                fc=[(off_r+a,off_c+b,cc) for a,b,cc in Or]
                bad=False
                for rr,cc,cv in fc:
                    if (rr,cc)==(mi,mj): continue
                    if not(0<=rr<H and 0<=cc<W) or I[rr][cc]!=bg: bad=True;break

import os,re,json,collections as C
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()

def comps(I,bg):
    H=len(I);W=len(I[0]);seen=set();out=[]
    for i in range(H):
        for j in range(W):
            if I[i][j]!=bg and (i,j) not in seen:
                st=[(i,j)];c=[]
                while st:
                    cur=st.pop()
                    if cur in seen: continue
                    seen.add(cur);c.append(cur)
                    for dr,dc in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                        n=(cur[0]+dr,cur[1]+dc)
                        if 0<=n[0]<H and 0<=n[1]<W and I[n[0]][n[1]]!=bg and n not in seen: st.append(n)
                out.append(c)
    return out

def dihed(cells):
    # returns list of normalized variants: (sorted(rel_cells with values), set of rel anchor coords that correspond to value v)
    res=[]
    cur=list(cells)
    for _ in range(2):
        for k in range(4):
            base=min(p[0] for p in cur);bse=min(p[1] for p in cur)
            rel=tuple(sorted((a-base,b-bse,I[a][b]) for a,b in cur))
            anchors=[(a,b) for a,b,_ in rel]
            res.append((rel,anchors))
            cur=[(b,a) for a,b in cur]
        cur=[(a,-b) for a,b in cur]
    return res

def solve(I):
    H=len(I);W=len(I[0])
    cnt=C.Counter(x for r in I for x in r);bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    C_all=comps(I,bg)
    tmpl=[c for c in C_all if len(c)>1]
    O=[r[:] for r in I]; placed=set()
    for mi,mj in [(i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W)]:
        v=I[mi][mj]
        if v==bg or any((mi,mj) in c for c in tmpl): continue
        best=None
        for tc in tmpl:
            vals=[I[a][b] for a,b in tc]
            if v not in vals: continue
            for rel,anchors in dihed(list(tc)):
                ar,acr=anchors[0]
                off_r=mi-ar;off_c=mj-acr
                fc=[];bad=False
                for a,b,cv in rel:
                    rr,cc=a+off_r,b+off_c
                    if (rr,cc)==(mi,mj): continue
                    if not(0<=rr<H and 0<=cc<W) or I[rr][cc]!=bg: bad=True;break
                    fc.append((rr,cc,cv))
                if bad: continue
                key=(''.join(str(x) for x in rel), ar*10+acr)
                if best is None or len(fc)>len(best[1]):
                    best=(key,fc,rel)
        if best is None: continue
        key,fc,rel=best
        for r_,c_,val in fc: O[r_][c_]=val
        placed|=set((f[0],f[1]) for f in fc)
    return O

ok=True
for d in range(1,9):
    I=G[f'Demo pair {d} input'];O_=G[f'Demo pair {d} output']
    S=solve(I)
    bad=[(i,j,S[i][j],O_[i][j]) for i in range(len(S)) for j in range(len(S[0])) if S[i][j]!=O_[i][j]]
    print('demo',d,'PASS' if not bad else f'mismatch {len(bad)} {bad[:6]}')

# The accent cell (the 3 inside the 5-block) — align it with each singleton marker.
def solve(p):
    ki,ko=G[f'Demo pair {p} input'],G[f'Demo pair {p} output']
    H,W=len(ki),len(ki[0])
    bgc=Counter(x for r in ki for x in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    objs=[(col,c) for col in set(x for r in ki for x in r)-{bgc} for c in new_comps(ki,col) if len(c)>1]
    singles=[]
    for col in set(x for r in ki for x in r)-{bgc}:
        for c in new_comps(ki,col):
            if len(c)==1: singles.append((col,c[0]))
    out=[r[:] for r in ki]
    used=set()
    hits=[]
    for mcol,(mi,mj) in singles:
        matched=False
        for tcol,tpl in objs:
            acr=next((a for a,b in tpl if ki[a][b]!=tcol))
            acj=next((b for a,b in tpl if ki[a][b]!=tcol))
            # check accent color matches marker color
            if ki[mpos[0]][mpos[1]]!=tcol and kr not in () : continue
        # simpler: try aligning accent to marker
        mr=min(i for i,_ in tpl); mc=min(j for _,j in tpl)
        ar=acr-mr; ac_=acj-mc
        sr=mi-ar; sc=mj-ac_
        newcells=[(sr+a,sc+b) for a,b in tpl]
        if all(0<=x<H and 0<=y<W for x,y in newcells):
            for x,y in newcells:
                if (x,y) not in used and out[x][y]==bgc: out[x][y]=tcol
            matched=True
        elif any(0<=x<H and 0<=y<W for x,y in newcells):
            partial=sum(1 for x,y in newcells if 0<=x<H and 0<=y<W)
            hits.append(('partial',matched,len(newcells)))
    return out,singles,hits
for p in range(1,9):
    out,sings,h=solve(p)
    print('pair',p,'singles:',[(s[0],s[1]) for s in sings],'partial-stamp-count:',sum(1 for r in h if r[0]=='partial'))

steps.input:
for p in [1,3,8]:
    ki=G[f'Demo pair {p} input']; ko=G[f'Demo pair {p} output']
    H=len(ki);W=len(ki[0])
    bg=Counter(x for r in ki for x in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    Cs=comps(ki,bg)
    T=max(Cs,key=len)
    br=min(r for r,_ in T);bc=min(c for _,c in T)
    P={(r-br,c-bc):ki[r][c] for r,c in T}
    maj=Counter(v for v in P.values()).most_common(1)[0][0]
    accs=[off for off,v in P.items() if v!=maj]
    singles=sorted((next(iter(c)),ki[next(iter(c))[0]][next(iter(c))[1]]) for c in Cs if len(c)==1)
    print(f'pair{p}: bg={bg} maj={maj} accents={[v for o,v in accs]} count={len(accs)}')
    # For each single, find translations where template copy covers marker position (any template cell == marker pos has value matching marker? or accent on marker?)
    for (mr,mc),mcol in singles:
        best=None
        for dr in range(-br+max(0,-mr), H+br):
            for dc in range(-bc+max(0,-mc), W+bc):
                # does translated template contain a valid placement with accent covering (mr,mc)?
                hits=[o for o in accs if 0<=mr-(o[0]+dr)<H and 0<=mc-(o[1]+dc)<W]
                allcover=all(0<=r+dr<H and 0<=c+dc<W and ki[r][c]==P[(r,c)] for r,c in P if (0<=r+dr<H and 0<=c+dc<W))
                acnt=len(hits)
                cand=(allcover,acnt,dr,dc)
                if best is None or cand>best: best=cand
        if best:
            dr,dc=best[2],best[3]
            alo=sorted(o for o in accs if 0<=mr-(o[0]+dr)<H and 0<=mc-(o[1]+dc)<W)
            print('   single',(mr,mc),'col',mcol,'top-left',(dr,dc),'accentcovers:',alo)
